sentence_stem: I wish I had studied harder for the exam,
correct_completion: because I could have passed it easily.
full_sentence: I wish I had studied harder for the exam, because I could have passed it easily.
acceptable_variants: so I would have felt more confident now.
and I would not be so worried today.

options.why_wrong: This uses a present tense that does not express regret about a past action, so it does not fit the wish about the past.

options.text: because I could have passed it easily.

options.why_wrong: 'Will' describes a future plan, which does not complete a past regret introduced by 'I wish I had'.

options.text: even though the exam was easy.
options.why_wrong: This adds a contrast that does not complete the regret; the sentence needs a consequence of studying more.

grammar_focus: Wish with past perfect and modal perfect (could have + past participle)
explanation: After 'I wish I had', the speaker regrets a past action, so the completion should use a past modal perfect to show what was possible in the past. Learners often use a simple present form here, so the past structure must be kept consistent throughout the sentence.
translation: Sınava daha çok çalışsaydım keşke, çünkü onu kolayca geçebilirdim.
